notes:
Short summary: CodeTether builds an in-IDE copilot aimed at enterprise CI workflows. Interested in function/tool calling so code agent can: run unit tests, run linting/static analysis, surface and stream build logs, and run ephemeral integration tests inside a sandbox.

Key quotes / asks:
- "We must never leak secrets or customer data through completions or logs" — Eng Lead
- "Need <50ms keystroke-to-suggestion for local dev; streaming is non-negotiable" — Head of Platform
- "Model pinning required per-customer; rollbacks must be trivial" — Security

Technical preferences / constraints:
- Prefer private/dedicated deployment: need control over ephemeral runner networking and KMS keys.
- Sandboxing strategy: evaluate Firecracker / gVisor / container-based ephemeral runners. Must support snapshot/rollforward for test state.
- Function-calling surface: test-run (pytest/jest), linter (flake/ruff/eslint), build executor (stream logs back to IDE), and a safe eval shim with strict syscall/networking restrictions.
- Observability: need per-request token cost + latency traces; tie regressions to prompt set and test-suite pass rates.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay for Dedicated but expect Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend for CI log-heavy flows.

Eng notes (shorthand):
- POC: 3-week trial, 2k dev hours, need RBAC + SSO baseline.
- Ask: provide sample repo integration (monorepo with JS/Python) and prebuilt sandbox runner image.
- Security flagged: retention policy for build logs (30/90/365 options), legal wants DPA clause around ephemeral logs.

Stakes: CodeTether sells an IDE plugin to banks and fintechs; compliance is a showstopper.
